reviewDecisions.rationale: Physical oil disruption and official extraction profits support a real value-chain transfer; expectation duration is the core deep-research question.
Independent reports show a real global potash/fertilizer shortage with direct producer economics, but duration and demand destruction must be tested.
Supplier withdrawal creates a specific structural pricing mechanism that can be mapped to verified listed-company exposure.
The >$100k nickel print was dominated by a short squeeze and exchange intervention, so spot price cannot serve as a clean earnings bridge.
Specialist evidence explicitly says inventories/alternatives should prevent near-term fab stoppages; cost risk alone is insufficient.
Lockdown/PMI deterioration is a timing contradiction for other theses rather than a narrow long opportunity.
